rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides enterprise-grade code intelligence through a hosted analysis platform designed for business leaders. Supports creating accounts, managing projects, analyzing codebases across any tech stack, and retrieving detailed reports covering security vulnerabilities, code quality, complexity metrics, licensing, and technical debt. Integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and Azure DevOps, with analysis results delivered as PDF reports.
